versions.content: {DRAFT} For a Time Slave of a Synchronized Time Base if • the Fallback Virtual Local Time is configured (i.e., StbMFallbackTime- Clock is configured) • and the Primary Virtual Local Time has become available again (e.g. after an outage) • and the Fallback Virtual Local Time is available, when StbM_BusSetGlobalTime is called, then the StbM shall derive the SyncLo- cal Time Tuple as follows: • calculate TL Sync according to Equation 7.2 • and set TV Sync to TV Primary before the Main Time Triple is updated.
